text:
ashok: kicking off AP-NE3 capacity intake for the new cluster. need to lock quota + soft reservation for bring-up window (2wk). proposing starter commit: 12xT4 + 4xA100 to save cost while we validate networking. any objections?

maria: sounds reasonable. can we request burstable quota instead of full commit? want to avoid long-term cost if we overshoot.

kevin: procurement note: if you file a GCP quota request for 4xA100 and 12xT4, attach expected start/stop dates and the ticket id. finance prefers calendar-month commits; short windows are fine but we need the cost estimate.

ashok: creating ticket now: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INFRA-2648 - includes rough perf targets and validation steps. will paste quota payload below.

ashok: quota request snippet (copy into GCP console -> Quotas):
```
Project: redwood-apne3-boot
Regions: asia-northeast3
Requested: GPUs: A100: 4, T4: 12
Start: 2026-06-01
End: 2026-06-14
Reason: cluster bring-up + smoke tests + perf tuning
Ticket: INFRA-2648
```

maria: also add a note about fallback routing: during bring-up route <10% production traffic to apne3 and enable auto-fallback to hosted region. That will let us validate KV cache behavior under real traffic without going all-in.

kevin: finance wants an estimated monthly burn for that window. ashok, can you drop a guesstimate? we can put it in the quota request comments.

ashok: rough calc: T4 on reserved hour-equivalent ~ $0.35/hr * 12 * 24 *14 = ~1400; A100 ~ $3/hr *4 *24 *14 = ~4032 => total ~5.5k for the two weeks. add ~10% buffer for network/backplane egress = ~6.1k. (very rough).

sophie: ops checklist reminder: before we spin GPU instances we need:
- VPC peering + subnet CIDR check
- Private GKE nodepool config templated
- KMS key ready for model artifacts
- Prometheus scrape targets & alerting rule stub
Please add this to INFRA-2648.

ashok: added checklist items to INFRA-2648. also opening a tiny canary: 2xT4 + 1xA100 as a smoke reservation while quota approval processes. filing a second short request for that so we can start infra QA.

kevin: perfect. procurement will file the official quota with GCP SLA team once you paste the final comments. cc: @sophie for KMS approval.

oncall-bot: Incident assignment created -> INFRA-2648 assigned to ashok. Due date: 2026-06-02.

maria: one more ask — can we request ability to convert some of the T4 quota to T4 preemptible so we can lower cost during tuning? GCP supports preemptible GPUs in this region. Add as optional field in the request.

ashok: will include optional preemptible flag and fallback policy. putting final comments now and will ping when request is submitted. thanks all :thumbsup:
